text:
Alex: Kicking off the eu-central2 region soak/ramp now — 6h window starting at 1941000000. Plan: bootstrap nodes -> warm KV/cache -> staged ramp -> validate autoscaler profiles. Asking infra oncall for watch.

CJ: ack. Which autoscaler profiles are we testing? A = conservative (min 10, max 80), B = aggressive (min 10, max 150) and C = cost-optimized (min 6, max 60, slower scale-up).

Mira: noticed one thing during bootstrap: driver init on a G5 pod timed out once, node restarted. Will grab logs. tagging @CJ.

CJ: copy — please paste the kubelet logs if you see it again. We increased init timeout to 8m for this roll.

Juan: cache priming note: run the prefix filler to populate KV and GPU KV cache. Use ramp script:
```bash
./ramp.sh --region eu-central2 --target-tokens 200000 --stages 3 --stage-duration 120
```
This primes short-prefix reuse patterns so batching hits are realistic.

Tara: cost FYI — aggressive profile (B) will spike GPU hours. We should enable autoscale cooldowns and a short cap on burst nodes to avoid runaway. Put a hard cap of 160 GPUs for first 3h.

Ben: posting quick PromQL to watch token throughput and P50 latency:
```
sum(rate(redwood_tokens_generated_total[1m]))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(redwood_response_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
Will stream graphs to #dashboards.

ops-bot: [alert] node eu-c2-gpu-07 restarted (kubelet exit). Reason: driver timeout.

Mira: attaching excerpt from node log: "NVIDIA driver failed to initialize: timeout waiting for device" — kernel is 5.15, driver v525. I'm rolling a node-repair play to re-pull driver.

CJ: possible OOM on init? Check dmesg for prevented module loads. Also confirm nvidia-container-runtime version.

Juan: re ramp — starting stage 1 now: target 25% of peak (50k tokens/s) for 20m to validate autoscaler reaction.

Alex: monitoring: if P50 latency > 200ms for 3 consecutive minutes OR error rate > 1% we pause ramp. Also if node restarts >3 in 10m we abort and fallback to eu-west2.

Tara: @Alex what about cost alerts? Would like an estimated delta for B vs C profiles for 6h soak.

Ben: preliminary estimate: profile B adds +28 GPU-hours over baseline during peak, profile C adds +8 GPU-hours. Rough $/GPU-hour = internal rate. I'll send numbers to finance slack.

Mira: repaired driver on two nodes; re-scheduled pods. No more driver errors in last 6m.

soak-bot: stage 1 complete — system scaled from 12->28 GPUs, average scale-up time 75s, queue length dropped 42%.

CJ: good. Observed autoscaler policy A (conservative) only added 8 GPUs; B added 16; C added 6. We should tune target utilization threshold down by 5% for A to avoid under-scaling.

Juan: starting stage 2 ramp to 70% peak (140k tokens/s) for 30m. Enabling prefix cache eviction monitor.

Tara: enabling short-term budget cap: if GPU-hours > 90 for first 2h then automatically switch to cost-optimized profile C.

Alex: note on networking — cross-region fallback path tested: traffic can re-route to eu-west2 but will add ~60ms RTT. Keep an eye on connection churn to clients during failover test.

Ben: Prom dashboard: token rate stable, P50 170ms, error rate 0.3%. No network spikes yet.

ops-bot: [notice] 3 minor pod restarts across different nodes in 10 minutes — restarted due to image pull backoff transient.

Mira: those were parallel image pulls during the prime; added jitter and local registry mirror for remaining nodes.

CJ: tuning note — lowering scale-down stabilization from 10m -> 5m gives faster reclamation but risks flapping. For launch we keep 10m. Post-soak we can test 5m.

Juan: stage 3 will go to full target (200k tokens/s) for 1h, then gradual step down to observe scale-down behavior. Starting now.

Tara: cost alert threshold triggered at 1941000300 — we hit 95 GPU-hours predicted. Switching to profile C in 2m.

Alex: hold profile switch until we verify latencies after stage 3 start — if P50 > 220ms we keep B for another 20m.

soak-bot: stage 3 live — GPUs peaked at 148, average scale-up time 82s, observed batching efficiency +18% from warm cache.

Ben: current metrics: P50 210ms, error rate 0.8%. We're within abort thresholds but close.

Mira: small network flap detected — transient packet loss to one AZ for ~90s, failover seemed to route traffic internally and didn't drop active sessions. Logging for postmortem.

CJ: because of the flap, recommend increasing request retry to 2 with 200ms jitter for client SDKs to make handoff smoother.

Alex: agree. After soak completes we do a quick HFO (handoff) doc for oncall with steps: how to revert profiles, how to trigger region failover, how to read batching impact charts.

Tara: final cost note: overall soak will cost ~X (sent privately) — recommend applying negotiated reserved credit for next 48h to offset.

soak-bot: soak complete (6h). Summary: no aborts, max GPUs 148, avg P50 185ms, error rate 0.6%, autoscaler profiles behaved as expected, driver init incidents mitigated.

Alex: huge thanks. Next actions: 1) CJ & Mira draft HFO/handoff + playbook for driver recovery 2) Juan export ramp scripts and results 3) Ben send final cost delta to finance 4) Tara confirm budget credit applied. We'll reconvene in post-soak sync at 1941001200. :thumbsup:

Ben: copying graphs and logs into the runbook now.

Mira: starting driver recovery playbook PR.

CJ: will update autoscaler thresholds and open PR for A -> decrease util threshold by 5%.

ops-bot: [action] runbook created: /runbooks/eu-central2-soak-1941000000.md

Alex: closing thread — excellent work everyone. :party_popper:
